subject: website
name: Hostile Heavens
summary: Hostile Heavens, a browser space game with wallet sign-in. Its bundle is minified with no source map and no public repository was found, so it stays at Level 2. When it opens it connects a WebSocket to the GUN relay gundb-relay.fly.dev for online state.

connections.name: GUN relay (gundb-relay.fly.dev)
connections.note: WebSocket opened when the page loads.
